title.de: Das Präsens: I walk, she walks
title.it: Il presente: I walk, she walks

goal.sl: Poveš, kaj kdo dela vedno znova in kaj vedno drži (I walk, she walks), z -es in -ies, kjer je treba, s has in s tem, kako pogosto, na koncu.
goal.de: Du sagst, was jemand immer wieder tut und was immer so ist (I walk, she walks), mit -es und -ies, wo es nötig ist, mit has und dem Wie-oft am Ende.
goal.it: Dici che cosa fa qualcuno di solito e che cosa è sempre vero (I walk, she walks), con -es e -ies dove serve, con has e il quanto spesso alla fine.
goal.en: You can say what people do again and again and what is always so (I walk, she walks), with -es and -ies where they belong, has, and how often at the end.

say.sl: present simple (sedanjik) pove, kaj delaš vedno znova in kaj vedno drži: **I walk to the inn every evening.** (Vsak večer grem peš v gostilno.) **We drink tea in the morning.** (Zjutraj pijemo čaj.) Pri **I**, **you**, **we** in **they** je glagol tak kot v slovarju: **I walk**, **you walk**, **they walk**. Ena oblika za štiri osebe.
say.de: Das present simple sagt, was du immer wieder tust und was immer so ist: **I walk to the inn every evening.** (Ich gehe jeden Abend zu Fuß ins Gasthaus.) **We drink tea in the morning.** (Morgens trinken wir Tee.) Bei **I**, **you**, **we** und **they** steht das Verb wie im Wörterbuch: **I walk**, **you walk**, **they walk**. Eine Form für vier Personen.
say.it: Il present simple dice che cosa fai di solito e che cosa è sempre vero: **I walk to the inn every evening.** (Ogni sera vado a piedi alla locanda.) **We drink tea in the morning.** (La mattina beviamo il tè.) Con **I**, **you**, **we** e **they** il verbo è come nel dizionario: **I walk**, **you walk**, **they walk**. Una forma sola per quattro persone.
say.en: The present simple says what you do again and again, and what is always so: **I walk to the inn every evening.** **We drink tea in the morning.** With **I**, **you**, **we** and **they**, the verb is just as in the dictionary: **I walk**, **you walk**, **they walk**. One form for four people.

say.sl: Pri **he**, **she**, **it** in enem imenu dodaš **-s**: **Jack walks Meg every morning.** (Jack vsako jutro sprehaja Meg.) **Mrs Birkett makes tea.** (Gospa Birkett skuha čaj.) **It rains a lot here.** (Tu veliko dežuje.) To **-s** je edina končnica sedanjika in rado se pozabi: **she works**, nikoli *she work*. Pred njim ni **is**: **she makes**, ne *she is make*.
say.de: Bei **he**, **she**, **it** und einem Namen kommt **-s** dazu: **Jack walks Meg every morning.** (Jack geht jeden Morgen mit Meg spazieren.) **Mrs Birkett makes tea.** (Mrs Birkett kocht Tee.) **It rains a lot here.** (Hier regnet es viel.) Dieses **-s** ist die einzige Endung des present simple und schnell vergessen: **she works**, nie *she work*. Kein **is** davor: **she makes**, nicht *she is make*.
say.it: Con **he**, **she**, **it** e un nome si aggiunge **-s**: **Jack walks Meg every morning.** (Jack porta a spasso Meg ogni mattina.) **Mrs Birkett makes tea.** (Mrs Birkett fa il tè.) **It rains a lot here.** (Qui piove molto.) Questa **-s** è l'unica desinenza del present simple, e si dimentica facilmente: **she works**, mai *she work*. Niente **is** davanti: **she makes**, non *she is make*.
say.en: With **he**, **she**, **it** and one name, add **-s**: **Jack walks Meg every morning.** **Mrs Birkett makes tea.** **It rains a lot here.** This **-s** is the only ending of the present simple, and it is easy to forget: **she works**, never *she work*. No **is** before it: **she makes**, not *she is make*.

say.sl: Kot v množini je za s, sh, ch in x končnica **-es**: **watches** (gleda), **washes** (umiva), **fixes** (popravlja), **misses** (zamudi), zlog več. Tudi **go** in **do** dobita **-es**: **goes** (gre), **does** (dela). **Mr Dixon fixes the gate.** (Gospod Dixon popravlja vrata.) **The bus goes to Keswick twice a day.** (Avtobus vozi v Keswick dvakrat na dan.)
say.de: Wie beim Plural heißt das **-s** nach s, sh, ch und x **-es**: **watches** (schaut), **washes** (wäscht), **fixes** (repariert), **misses** (verpasst), eine Silbe mehr. Auch **go** und **do** bekommen **-es**: **goes** (geht), **does** (macht). **Mr Dixon fixes the gate.** (Mr Dixon repariert das Tor.) **The bus goes to Keswick twice a day.** (Der Bus fährt zweimal am Tag nach Keswick.)
say.it: Come nel plurale, dopo s, sh, ch e x la **-s** diventa **-es**: **watches** (guarda), **washes** (lava), **fixes** (ripara), **misses** (perde), una sillaba in più. Anche **go** e **do** prendono **-es**: **goes** (va), **does** (fa). **Mr Dixon fixes the gate.** (Mr Dixon ripara il cancello.) **The bus goes to Keswick twice a day.** (L'autobus va a Keswick due volte al giorno.)
say.en: As in the plural, after s, sh, ch and x the **-s** is **-es**: **watches**, **washes**, **fixes**, **misses**, one syllable more. **go** and **do** take **-es** too: **goes**, **does**. **Mr Dixon fixes the gate.** **The bus goes to Keswick twice a day.**

say.sl: Soglasnik + **y** postane **-ies**: **fly** → **flies** (leti), **carry** → **carries** (nese), **study** → **studies** (študira). Samoglasnik + y doda samo -s: **play** → **plays** (igra), **buy** → **buys** (kupi). **have** pa je **has**: **Auntie Edna has a little radio.** (Teta Edna ima majhen radio.) **Arthur carries his hives up the fell.** (Arthur nese svoje panje na hrib.)
say.de: Ein Konsonant + **y** wird zu **-ies**: **fly** → **flies** (fliegt), **carry** → **carries** (trägt), **study** → **studies** (studiert). Ein Vokal + y bekommt nur -s: **play** → **plays** (spielt), **buy** → **buys** (kauft). Und **have** heißt **has**: **Auntie Edna has a little radio.** (Tante Edna hat ein kleines Radio.) **Arthur carries his hives up the fell.** (Arthur trägt seine Bienenstöcke auf den Berg.)
say.it: Consonante + **y** diventa **-ies**: **fly** → **flies** (vola), **carry** → **carries** (porta), **study** → **studies** (studia). Vocale + y prende solo -s: **play** → **plays** (gioca), **buy** → **buys** (compra). E **have** diventa **has**: **Auntie Edna has a little radio.** (Zia Edna ha una radiolina.) **Arthur carries his hives up the fell.** (Arthur porta le sue arnie sul monte.)
say.en: A consonant + **y** becomes **-ies**: **fly** → **flies**, **carry** → **carries**, **study** → **studies**. A vowel + y just adds -s: **play** → **plays**, **buy** → **buys**. And **have** is **has**: **Auntie Edna has a little radio.** **Arthur carries his hives up the fell.**

say.sl: present simple je za navade in dejstva: **Bees make honey.** (Čebele delajo med.) **It rains a lot in the Lakes.** (V Jezerskem okrožju veliko dežuje.) Kako pogosto, poveš na koncu: **every day** (vsak dan), **every morning** (vsako jutro), **on Saturdays** (ob sobotah), **in the evening** (zvečer), **twice a day** (dvakrat na dan). Angleščina vedno pove, kdo: **It rains.**, nikoli *Rains.*; **She works at the inn.** (Dela v gostilni.)
say.de: Das present simple ist für Gewohnheiten und Tatsachen: **Bees make honey.** (Bienen machen Honig.) **It rains a lot in the Lakes.** (Im Lake District regnet es viel.) Wie oft, steht am Ende: **every day** (jeden Tag), **every morning** (jeden Morgen), **on Saturdays** (samstags), **in the evening** (abends), **twice a day** (zweimal am Tag). Englisch sagt immer, wer: **It rains.** (Es regnet.), nie *Rains.*; **She works at the inn.** (Sie arbeitet im Gasthaus.)
say.it: Il present simple è per le abitudini e i fatti: **Bees make honey.** (Le api fanno il miele.) **It rains a lot in the Lakes.** (Nel Lake District piove molto.) Quanto spesso, lo dici alla fine: **every day** (ogni giorno), **every morning** (ogni mattina), **on Saturdays** (il sabato), **in the evening** (la sera), **twice a day** (due volte al giorno). L'inglese dice sempre chi: **It rains.** (Piove.), mai *Rains.*; **She works at the inn.** (Lavora alla locanda.)
say.en: The present simple is for habits and facts: **Bees make honey.** **It rains a lot in the Lakes.** Say how often at the end: **every day**, **every morning**, **on Saturdays**, **in the evening**, **twice a day**. And English always says who: **It rains.**, never *Rains.*; **She works at the inn.**, never *Works at the inn.*

examples.en: It rains a lot in the Lake District.
examples.de: Im Lake District regnet es viel.

examples.sl: Gospa Birkett vsak dan dela v gostilni.
examples.de: Mrs Birkett arbeitet jeden Tag im Gasthaus.
examples.it: Mrs Birkett lavora alla locanda ogni giorno.

exercises.text: Every morning Shepherd Jack ___ (walk) up the fell with Meg. Granny Maggie ___ (make) scones, and Poppy ___ (carry) them to the inn. Mr Dixon ___ (fix) the gates, and the bus ___ (go) to Keswick twice a day. In the evening the walkers ___ (come) to the inn.

translation.sl: Vsako jutro gre pastir Jack z Meg na hrib. Babica Maggie peče scone, Poppy pa jih nese v gostilno. Gospod Dixon popravlja vrata, avtobus pa vozi v Keswick dvakrat na dan. Zvečer pohodniki pridejo v gostilno.
translation.de: Jeden Morgen geht Schäfer Jack mit Meg auf den Berg. Oma Maggie backt Scones, und Poppy trägt sie ins Gasthaus. Mr Dixon repariert die Tore, und der Bus fährt zweimal am Tag nach Keswick. Am Abend kommen die Wanderer ins Gasthaus.
translation.it: Ogni mattina il pastore Jack sale sul monte con Meg. Nonna Maggie fa gli scones, e Poppy li porta alla locanda. Mr Dixon ripara i cancelli, e l'autobus va a Keswick due volte al giorno. La sera gli escursionisti vengono alla locanda.
translation.en: Every morning Shepherd Jack walks up the fell with Meg. Granny Maggie makes scones, and Poppy carries them to the inn. Mr Dixon fixes the gates, and the bus goes to Keswick twice a day. In the evening the walkers come to the inn.
